description: This file defines a dataset class for COCO object detection, including functions for converting annotations to masks, applying transformations, and building dataset instances for training and validation.

classes.name: CocoDetection
classes.description: A dataset class for COCO detection, extending torchvision's CocoDetection with additional preprocessing.

classes.name: ConvertCocoPolysToMask
classes.description: A helper class to convert COCO polygon annotations to masks and prepare targets for detection models.

methods.name: convert_coco_poly_to_mask
methods.description: Converts polygon segmentations to binary masks using pycocotools.

methods.name: make_coco_transforms
methods.description: Creates data augmentation and normalization transforms for COCO dataset based on the dataset split.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a COCO dataset instance for training or validation based on provided arguments.
